game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow, a hollow of roosting bats: the cave miner must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Condition Builder: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow: a hollow of roosting bats
core_gameplay_loop: In Bat Hollow, repeat each round: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times. Each round, glow-eyed lurkers strike the exit ledge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the loop_runs value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the exit ledge from glow-eyed lurkers in Bat Hollow: keep the loop_runs meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: loop_runs drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Condition Builder
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_runs changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Bat Hollow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while loop_runs > 0.
